facts.description: Docker server monitoring without the stack. Metrics, logs, and alerts from your terminal. Single binary, zero exposed ports, SSH-only.

research.name: tori
research.note: Docker server monitoring TUI over SSH with braille sparklines, grouped containers, alerts and log tailing.

effects: braille-dot CPU and memory sparklines in a centered single-column dashboard
containers grouped by compose project with status dots, health marks and running counts
alert view pairing firing alerts with their rule expressions
log tail with colored levels under per-group sparklines and a firing-alert banner
monitoring over SSH to a Unix socket with no exposed ports
